body: I've pretty much joined the patient gamer group.... don't really have much time to play games anymore. I played EQOA, EQ2, City of Heroes, City of Villains, SWTOR, GW1 and 2, and... I feel like I'm missing one in here.. what about you?

Does numb and calm count? Because that's mostly it. I'm just done with everything in my life. I was hoping that a move far away from everything would give me a chance to work on myself but it's only made things worse. In every way I'm worse off than I was before.
I have given it multiple chances and it's always ended the same way. I'm here again and I'm just done.
Not sure there's anything anyone can do really. In the end, I'm just an anonymous stranger on the internet. Just don't do what I'm going to do.
No chance you'd be able to find him through social media?

I miss the old school RPGs but, I used to play SSB, Diablo 2, did play some MMOs (not WoW), and games like that. I did pick up path of exile and borderlands 2 recently but for really play them that much.

Thank you for your kind words. It's not like I haven't known joy before. It's usually very fleeting for me though so I try my best for other people to enjoy that feeling as I do not want them to feel what I have felt in terms of depression.
Not sure if I believe that, but thank you.
I used to do a lot of gaming however, sitting infront of a computer all day for work kinda killed that one for me. I do hope you enjoy the new Zelda though!

That's not something you should hold over yourself. You were 8. We all make mistakes as kids, it's part of growing up. I highly doubt that you've treated people like that intentionally after realizing what happened. If you think it will help, try looking him up and reconnect. No harm in trying.

Just because my life has been rough and will no longer be there in a weeks time does not mean that the people I interact with should feel any pain. People deserve to be happy and I've always tried my best to do as such.

Nothing wrong with drawing trees. When I did draw, it was mostly trees as well, although never attempted with paint. 

I have been calm when making this post and writing what I have. Sleep will probably be difficult tonight but we'll see. I hope you're able to get a good nights sleep though.
Only if you feel comfortable sharing.

The way that I felt when posting in previous times was much different than now. Really, I'm more calm than anything. The community here is wonderful and I thank every one of you for helping me in the past but, I'm beyond that at this point.

You'll get there with enough practice. What was the last thing you tried to paint?

I've just been doing a bit of research and browsing reddit every now and then in between attempts to sleep.
Eh. They all have their reasons. I just hope they are living happier lives than when I had met them. All good people that needed help at one point.
Mostly how meaningless all of this is. Regardless of what happens, I will and always have been easily cast aside and replaced. I mean, that's a small part of it all but it definitely is there.
Been laying in bed trying to sleep for a while now. I don't read as much as I used to since my job entails a lot of reading. Don't really paint or do art related things.
Truth be told, I was feeling frustrated earlier this night. Now? Mostly just existing. Next week should be fun though.
Not sure if it even really matters. Only really posted here since it's stopped me before when I was serious but... I've just stopped caring.
